minimum_validation_rule: value must match one approved packet class and at least one open blocker/workorder
why_it_matters: prevents orphan evidence from floating in the cube
redaction_or_annex_rule: public identifier may be shown; linked sensitive row IDs may be suppressed

minimum_validation_rule: owner_role and backup_owner must be nonblank and accountable to a jurisdiction/licensee/lab/public-health function
why_it_matters: closure requires a responsible organization, not a document
redaction_or_annex_rule: names may be role-based publicly and identifiable in confidential annex

minimum_validation_rule: verifier_role must differ from owner_role or self-attestation is capped
why_it_matters: prevents self-certified readiness
redaction_or_annex_rule: public may show verifier class, not individual where sensitive

minimum_validation_rule: sha256 or equivalent content hash required for every artifact or redacted extract
why_it_matters: makes packet immutable and re-checkable
redaction_or_annex_rule: hash public-safe unless it reveals source system naming

minimum_validation_rule: artifact_date plus stale_if rule required; stale packets cannot close current readiness
why_it_matters: prevents expired rosters, plans, or exercise evidence from scoring
redaction_or_annex_rule: date can be public; exact roster extracts remain annexed

minimum_validation_rule: packet must name site, jurisdiction, zone/sector/domain, population/equipment/lab scope, and exclusions
why_it_matters: prevents a brochure or generic plan from closing a local gap
redaction_or_annex_rule: public scope generalized where security/privacy requires

minimum_validation_rule: packet must identify where contradictory later evidence, failed retest, complaint, PI/finding, or AAR item will reopen the row
why_it_matters: closure must be reversible when reality changes
redaction_or_annex_rule: public can show counterevidence channel category

minimum_validation_rule: redaction_class and public_safe_summary required before export
why_it_matters: real packets may contain PII, route/security, medical, student, producer, or EOF details
redaction_or_annex_rule: sensitive annex split mandatory

minimum_validation_rule: dated, de-duplicated, aggregated roster with return-rate/outreach audit and geocoding QA
why_it_matters: cards alone do not prove who needs pickup or what vehicle is required
redaction_or_annex_rule: PII aggregated; individual addresses suppressed

minimum_validation_rule: mobility categories mapped to accessible bus/wheelchair van/ambulance/staff/caregiver needs with backups
why_it_matters: roster without lift/ambulance/vendor capacity is not executable
redaction_or_annex_rule: vendor-specific vulnerabilities annexed

minimum_validation_rule: current producer contacts by product/animal/water category plus call-down or message test
why_it_matters: producer public pages do not prove reachable farms or processors
redaction_or_annex_rule: producer identities and exact inventory suppressed/aggregated

minimum_validation_rule: milk/produce/livestock/feed/water hold-release decision log, advisory language and compensation/claims interface
why_it_matters: prevents contaminated product from entering commerce and prevents stranded producers
redaction_or_annex_rule: commercially sensitive records annexed

minimum_validation_rule: sample kit inventory, field-team roster, custody forms, lab receipt QA/QC and turnaround evidence
why_it_matters: procedure listings do not prove field/lab capacity
redaction_or_annex_rule: sample locations and vulnerable routes generalized

required_element: current ETE artifact or authorized extract
minimum_validation_rule: artifact date, revision, scenario inventory, population basis, route assumptions, and source authority required
why_it_matters: public ETE table or KLD citation is not route proof
redaction_or_annex_rule: sensitive route details may be annexed; public scenario summary allowed

minimum_validation_rule: current RERP/EOP or authorized extract with alerting, route, reception, CRC, AFN, ingestion, AAR/CAP status
why_it_matters: tri-state readiness fails if one border jurisdiction is invisible
redaction_or_annex_rule: public plan summaries allowed; tactical/PII details annexed

minimum_validation_rule: restoration, root cause, backup generator chain, compensatory measures, retest, EP04 reconciliation, CAP closure
why_it_matters: public event notification cannot prove restored emergency response capability
redaction_or_annex_rule: EOF/security details suppressed or generalized

minimum_validation_rule: official result, evaluated objectives, deficiencies, CAP owners, due dates, retest and closure evidence
why_it_matters: future exercise schedule is not performance evidence
redaction_or_annex_rule: deficiency details reviewed before publication

minimum_validation_rule: facility openability, staffing, equipment, contamination screening, decon, medical diversion, shelter handoff and throughput evidence
why_it_matters: listed reception centers are not operational CRC proof
redaction_or_annex_rule: site constraints and medical details annexed

minimum_validation_rule: raw feed hash, parsed rows, unit/quarter, EP01/EP02/EP04, action matrix, contradictions and cap mapping
why_it_matters: public PI pages cannot close local rows but can reopen or cap claims
redaction_or_annex_rule: public-safe by default except security withholding

minimum_validation_rule: IPAWS/EAS/ENS/siren/backup route alerting plus ASL/caption/plain-language/TTY/LEP tests and rumor log
why_it_matters: alert sent is not alert received, understood, and acted upon
redaction_or_annex_rule: PII and message platform credentials suppressed
